questions.question: A person crosses an 1800-metre long street in 6 minutes. The speed of the person in km/h is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Distance = 1800 m

Time = 6 min 

**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

1 min = 60 sec

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Speed = Distance/Time

⇒ (1800/6 × 60) m/sec

⇒ 5 m/sec

The speed of person in km/h = (5 × 18/5) 

⇒ 18 km/h

**∴ Required speed of man is 18**

questions.question: A single discount equivalent to three successive discounts of 10%, 15% and 18%. is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Three successive discounts = 10%, 15% and 18%

**Formula used:**

Equivalent discount = (100 – Discounted value)/Initial value × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the initial value be 100

Discounted value = (100 – 10)% of (100 – 15)% of (100 – 18)% of 100

⇒ 90% of 85% of 82% of 100

⇒ (90/100 × 85/100 × 82/100 × 100)

⇒ 62.73%

Equivalent discount = (100 – Discounted value)/Initial value × 100

⇒ [(100 – 62.73)/100 × 100]

⇒ (37.27/100 × 100)

⇒ 37.27%

**∴ The required value is 37.27%**

questions.question: A, B and C can do a piece of work in 10, 15 and 30 days, respectively. If B and C both assist A on every third day, then in how many days will 40% of the work be completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Time taken by A = 10 days

Time taken by B= 15 days

Time taken by C = 30 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 10, 15 and 30 is 30 units

Efficiency of A = (30/10) = 3 units/day

Efficiency of B = (30/15) = 2 units/day

Efficiency of C = (30/30) = 1 unit/day

Work done by A in first 2 days = (3 × 2) = 6 

Work done by A, B and C in 3rd day = (3 + 2 + 1) units = 6 units

Work done by A, B and C in 3 days = (6 + 6) = 12 units

40% of the total work = 40% of 30 units

⇒ 12 units

Time taken to complete 12 units is 3 days as mentioned above

**∴ 40% of the work will be completed in 3 days**

questions.question: Three articles are bought at Rs. 180 each. One of them is sold at a loss of 10%, If the other two articles are sold so as to gain 20% on the whole transaction, then what is the gain percentage on the two articles?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost of three articles = Rs. 180 each

One article sold at loss = 10%

Two articles sold at gain = 20%

**Formula used:**

Gain% = Gain/CP × 100

**Calculation:**

Cost of three articles = Rs. (180 × 3)

⇒ Rs. 540

Total gain percentage on whole transaction = 20%

Then,

SP of all three articles = (540 × 120/100)

⇒ 648

SP of first article = (180 – 180 × 10%)

⇒ (180 –18)

⇒ 162

CP of other two article = 360

SP of other two article = (648 – 162)

⇒ 486

Gain on two article = (486 – 360)

⇒ 126

Gain% = (126/360 × 100)

⇒ 35%

**∴ The gain percentage on two articles is 35%**

questions.question: A hall is 18 m long and 12 m broad. If the area of the floor is equal to the sum of the areas of the four walls, the volume (in m³) of the hall is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of hall = 18 m

Breadth of hall = 12 m

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = l × b

Area of four walls = 2 × h × (l + b)

Volume of hall = l × b × h

**Calculation:**

Let h be the height of the hall

According to the question

Area of floor = Area of four walls

⇒ l × b = 2 × h × (l + b)

⇒ 18 × 12 = 2 × h × (18 + 12)

⇒ 2h = (18 × 12)/30

⇒ 2h = 36/5

⇒ h = 18/5

Volume of hall = l × b × h

⇒ (18 × 12 × 18/5) m³

⇒ (3888/5) m³

⇒ 777.6 m³

**∴ Volume of the hall is 777.6 m³**

questions.question: The incomes of A and B are in the ratio 6 ∶ 11. The ratio of their expenditures is 1 ∶ 2. If A and B save Rs. 9,000 and Rs. 11,500, respectively, then the expenditure of B is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of income of A and B = 6: 11

Ratio of their expenditure = 1 : 2

Saving of A = Rs. 9000

Saving of B = Rs. 11500

Formula used:

Income = Expenditure + Saving

**Calculation:**

Let the income of A and B be 6x and 11x respectively

The expenditure of A = 6x – 9000

The expenditure of B = 11x – 11500

According to the question

⇒ (6x – 9000)/(11x – 11500) = 1/2

⇒ 12x – 18000 = 11x – 11500

⇒ 12x – 11x = 18000 – 11500

⇒ x = 6500

Now, Expenditure of B = 11x – 11500

⇒ 11 × 6500 – 11500

⇒ 71500 – 11500

⇒ 60000

**∴ The expenditure of B is Rs. 60,000**

questions.question: The incomes of A and B are in the ratio 3 ∶ 4, and their expenditures are in the ratio 9 ∶ 5. If the income of A is equal to three times the expenditure of B, then what is the ratio of the savings of A and B?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Ratio of incomes of A and B = 3 : 4

Ratio of expenditure of A and B = 9 : 5

The income of A = 3 × The expenditure of B

**Formula used:**

Savings = Income – Expenditure

Income = Savings + Expenditure

Expenditure = Income – Savings

**Calculation:**

Let the income of A and B be 3x and 4x respectively

And the expenses of A and B be 9y and 5y respectively

The income of A = 3 × The expenditure of B

⇒ 3x = 3 × (5y)

⇒ 3x = 15y

⇒ x = 5y

The income of A = 3x = (3 × 5y) = 15y

The income of B = 4x = (4 × 5y) = 20y

Savings of A = (15y – 9y)

⇒ 6y

Savings of B = (20y – 5y)

⇒ 15y

The ratio of savings of A and B = (6y : 15y)

⇒ 2 : 5

**∴ Required ratio is 2 : 5**

questions.question: Two numbers are, respectively, 17% and 50% less than a third number. The ratio of the two numbers is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two numbers are, respectively, 17% and 50% less than a third number

**Calculation:**

Let the third number be x

First number = 83/100 × x = 83x/100

Second number = 50/100 × x = x/2

Ratio of two numbers = (83x/100) : (x/2)

⇒ 83 : 50

**∴ Required ratio is 83 : 50**

questions.question: A person invested a sum of Rs. 6,500 at x% per annum at simple interest and a sum of Rs. 7,500 at (x - 2)% at simple interest. If total interest earned on both the investments for 3 years is Rs. 3,750, then the rate of interest on the second investment is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal on first investment = Rs. 6500

Principal on 2nd investment = Rs. 7500

Time = 3 years

Total interest earned on both the investments = Rs. 3750

**Formula used:**

 SI = (P × R × T)/100

**Calculation:**

According to the question

⇒ (6500 × x × 3)/100 + (7500 × (x – 2) × 3)/100 = 3750

⇒ 195x + 225x – 450 = 3750

⇒ 420x = 3750 + 450

⇒ 420x = 4200

⇒ x = 10%

The rate of interest on second investment = (x – 2) = (10 – 2)

⇒ 8%

**∴ The rate of interest on second investment is 8%**

questions.question: if A and B can do a piece of work in 20 days, and A alone can do the same work in 60 days, then in how many days can B alone complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Work done by A and B together = 20 days

Work done by A alone = 60 days

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

LCM of 20 and 60 is 60

Efficiency of A and B together = (60/20) units

⇒ 3 units/day

Efficiency of A alone = (60/60) units

⇒ 1 unit/day

B alone can complete a work = [60/(3 – 1)] days

⇒ (60/2) days

⇒ 30 days

**∴ B alone can complete a work in 30 days**
